architecture_rule: Oblivion Findings is one operating organisation with multiple Sites. Bounded static route/action ownership does not establish permission, Site/privacy/direct-object/lifecycle correctness, runtime behaviour, or release readiness.

overlay_source_records.review_rationale: The edit action authorizes access, loads ingredients and tags, and returns editable recipe JSON; the non-JSON redirect and lack of a current rendered caller do not erase those positive action semantics.
The store action validates input and performs the recipe, tag, and ingredient creation transaction used by the Meal Planner dialog.
The update action validates input and performs the bound recipe, tag, and ingredient update transaction used by the Meal Planner dialog.
The destroy action authorizes and deletes the bound recipe under the canonical recipe-library job.
The index action returns the product catalogue, categories, and tags JSON used by the imported Meal Planner library dialog; its non-JSON redirect is only a fallback branch.
The store action validates input, creates a MealProduct, synchronizes tags, and serves the Meal Planner library dialog's JSON create request.
The update action validates and updates the bound MealProduct and tag relation for the canonical product-catalogue job.
The destroy action authorizes and deletes the bound MealProduct for the canonical product-catalogue job.
The JSON branch queries and returns the canonical dietary-tag library to a live imported Meal Planner dialog; only the non-JSON branch redirects.
The store action validates and creates a MealDietaryTag for the canonical dietary-tag-library job.
The update action validates and updates the bound MealDietaryTag for the canonical dietary-tag-library job.
The destroy action authorizes and deletes the bound MealDietaryTag for the canonical dietary-tag-library job.

reviewed_non_owner_outcomes.rationale: The index action only redirects direct or bookmarked recipe-library visits to the canonical Meal Planner surface.
The create action only redirects to the canonical Meal Planner route; the controller identifies its in-page recipe dialog as the creation surface.
The show action only redirects to the canonical Meal Planner surface and has no substantive route-action semantics of its own.
